newsitem.title: UK: SEPT FORTIES LOADINGS DOWN AT 23.17 MLN BARRELS.
newsitem.headline: SEPT FORTIES LOADINGS DOWN AT 23.17 MLN BARRELS.

text.p: The September loading programme for Britain's North Sea Forties crude export stream has been set at 23.17 million barrels, down from an expected 25.85 million in August, traders said on Thursday.
The September programme is made up of 20 cargoes of 600,000 barrels, 18 cargoes of 500,000 barrels and one cargo of one million barrels.
It also includes 1.17 million barrels pumped direct to Forties pipeline operator BP's refinery at Grangemouth, the traders said.
The August programme consisted of 30 cargoes of 600,000 barrels, eight cargoes of 500,000 barrels, two of 850,000 barrels and one of 650,000 barrels, plus 1.5 million barrels to Grangemouth.
Daily liftings of Forties in September are scheduled to average 772,000 barrels per day (bpd), down from 834,000 in August.
Forties loads at BP's Hound Point terminal in eastern Scotland.
